proof_groups.proof_strategy: Use the accepted head payload factor/unfactor bridges around the original structural traversal. Prefer the simplified second disjuncts of entail witnesses 2 and 3. Advance the prefix using singleton segment and concatenation. On exit derive an empty suffix from null, use tail_value_app_last, rebuild the structural head and restore identical payload records. No new helper is expected; optional proved convenience helpers must have the current group suffix in case_lib.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The old pointer sequence is conserved as prefix ++ current :: suffix while payload ownership stays framed. Nonzero guards permit node decomposition and prefix extension. A null successor forces an empty suffix and identifies the last pointer; a null initial successor returns the sentinel.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All five witnesses share the same tail traversal and payload preservation proof family; five is within the handoff limit of twelve. One group avoids duplicated setup without unrelated proof strategies.
